verdict_reason: FTW-global (CC-BY-4.0, direct HTTP/S3, India partition, no auth) and Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (open, GEE) are both open and fetch-verified. The blocker: real DCS supervisor manual-survey outcomes (AgriStack Crop Sown Registry/UFSI) gave HTTP 403 on both pages tried, no public dataset/API -- only application-gated access. Ground truth must be a constructed manual proxy, not real DCS data.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Annotators manually label a stratified sample of plots as observable/ambiguous/manual-required against a high-res basemap plus S2 cloud-QA bands, as a proxy -- real DCS supervisor manual-survey decisions are not publicly accessible.
ground_truth.label_count_estimate: ~500-1000 manually reviewed plots (proxy labels; no public DCS ground truth exists)

compute_path.platform: Direct HTTP/S3 download of India partition from Source Cooperative (FTW) + Google Earth Engine for Sentinel-2 QA/cloud layers + local geopandas/pandas processing on MacBook
compute_path.why: No model training: FTW boundaries are precomputed; task is rule-based S2 QA/cloud-band classification. Only India's partition of the 210GB set is needed, processed locally. Zero sustained GPU use.
